Trump hosts meme coin investors amid token price crash

Former U.S. President Donald Trump hosted a dinner event for investors of the $TRUMP meme coin at the Trump National Golf Club in Virginia. The event, described as more subdued than a previous gala, occurred as the $TRUMP token's value dropped below $1, leading to a significant decrease in investor wealth. The Trump Organization hosted the dinner to promote the cryptocurrency.
